name: Does compressing a PDF upload my file?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Compression happens entirely in your browser. Your PDF is never uploaded to any server or sent over the internet.

name: Will compression reduce the visual quality of my PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDFree offers three quality levels. The 'High' setting preserves near-original quality. Images may be slightly reduced at lower settings.

name: How much can PDFree reduce a PDF file size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typical reductions are 20–70%. Results depend on content: PDFs with many images compress more; text-only PDFs compress less.

name: Does PDF compression work without an internet connection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree works fully offline as a PWA once the page has loaded.
